title: Held-Seat Charges Outside Meal-Status Fee Waivers: Waiting-List Seats, Student Transportation Services
content:
Meal-status fee waivers of Student Transportation Services never reach a held-seat charge, the months billed for a seat offered from the waiting list and held before the family accepted it. In the seat waiver the held-seat charge is taken out of the seat fee before the status share is applied. The seat was offered on the assignment's stop assignment date.

| Offer compared with the fee's posting | Held months the fee carries |
|---|---|
| offered in an earlier calendar month than the month the fee posted, and the fee posted more than 10 calendar days after the offer | one held month (1) |
| offered in an earlier calendar month, and the fee posted 6 to 10 calendar days after the offer | half a held month (0.5) |
| any other case, or no stop is assigned | none |

**Held-seat charge.** The fee less its late application charge, if any, times the held months divided by the seat months plus the held months. The seat months are the whole calendar months from the month the fee posted through the last month of the permit period, that month included.

## Both sides (hypothetical)

| Seat offered | Fee posted | Days after the offer | Held months |
|---|---|---|---|
| January 26 | February 6 | 11 | 1 |
| January 26 | February 5 | 10 | 0.5 |
| January 26 | February 1 | 6 | 0.5 |
| January 27 | February 1 | 5 | none |

## Example (hypothetical)

A school-year seat fee of 126.00 USD posted in February (4 seat months), no late application charge, one held month: the held-seat charge is 126.00 times 1 divided by 5, 25.20, and the seat waiver acts on 100.80.
